$comment: Stand-in opponents for when there is no card art: one per mana colour (W U B R G C), a regular and a boss. Replaces the drawn Portrait in ModeArt.tsx.
style: Character portraits: head-and-shoulders bust of one fantasy duelist per cell, three-quarter view facing slightly left, looking toward the viewer, painted like a premium card game opponent portrait. The bust is cut off cleanly at the bottom of the chest, and head and shoulders fill the cell.
